reuse.why: Adds the flag to the existing getCategoriesForBulkBudgetAction selector and threads it through setBulkNMonthAvg, and makes copyPreviousMonth use the same selector instead of its own hidden check.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the only repetition is the `{ month; includeHiddenCategories? }` argument type spelled out on six actions instead of a shared type, plus the pre-existing per-site income check.

placement.why: The hidden rule lives in the one bulk-selection query in actions.ts where the other exclusions already live.

scope.why: Focused on the flag, but routing copyPreviousMonth through the selector also starts applying the template and #fixed exclusions there when the flag is off, a change beyond threading the flag.

maintainability.why: One selector now decides every month-wide action's categories; the repeated inline argument types are minor noise.

bypasses_abstraction.where: all month-wide actions, including copyPreviousMonth, go through getCategoriesForBulkBudgetAction

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth's local hidden check is removed and replaced by membership in the shared selector's result, not reshaped
